name: The Spider God
label: Quest
description: The Spider God: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Witherbarks worship a spider god, and from her they collect their most potent venom. So if you want the venom, then you must summon their god!
To do that, you must know her true name, and that name is on a tablet buried in Tanaris, in the troll city of Zul'Farrak, in a tomb guarded by Theka the Martyr.
Defeat Theka and find and read his tablet to discover the spider god's name. When you know it, return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you know the spider god's name?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Elortha no Shadra... Speak this name only in whispers, for its utterance carries much weight in the realms of the spirit.
I will put it to parchment and create for you a spell of summoning...
